answer: Audits are published in bridge, queued in onyx, and sonnet publishes the wait time. A farm of 211 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 17 identities per epoch. A farm of 4669 identities would post 3425 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
